---
title: Regression
---

This tutorial uses orthoDr 2.0.0. See [Get Started](get-started.html) for
installation and the complete R script.

```{r load-package, eval=FALSE}
library(orthoDr)
```

```{r guide, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
source(rprojroot::find_package_root_file("tools", "pkgdown-guide.R"), local = TRUE)
cat(guide_section("Fit a regression model and predict"), sep = "\n")
```

## Next steps

See `orthoDr_reg()` for the SIR, SAVE, PHD, locally efficient, and efficient
estimation methods, and `predict.orthoDr()` for the prediction arguments and
returned values. Choose the method and number of directions for your modeling
problem; the example settings do not provide an automatic selection rule.
